accounts.label: Email Accounts
accounts.description: One entry per mailbox. After filling in the OAuth client credentials, save, then use the 'Connect' button in the inbox view to authorize each account.

name.label: Account Name
name.description: A label for this account (e.g. 'Work Gmail')

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Which email service this account uses

clientId.label: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: From your Google Cloud or Azure app registration (see README)

clientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
clientSecret.description: From your Google Cloud or Azure app registration

tenant.label: Azure Tenant
tenant.description: Azure directory (tenant) ID, or 'common' for multi-tenant/personal accounts

targetNoteId.label: File Emails Under
targetNoteId.description: New notes created from this account's emails are placed as children of this note

refreshToken.label: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Populated automatically after you Connect this account. Leave blank; clear it to force re-authorization.

maxMessages.label: Messages to List
maxMessages.description: How many recent messages to fetch per account in the inbox view

deleteAfterCreate.label: Delete After Creating Note
deleteAfterCreate.description: When you create a note from an email, also delete (trash) that email from the account
